site.title: raqt fuel — London Catering
site.metaDescription: London's premier no-menu catering service. Any cuisine, any culture, any dietary need — cooked flawlessly for private dining, corporate events and weddings.

hero.title:
We Cook
Anything You Crave
hero.subtitle: No menu. No limits. Tell us what you want — from any cuisine, any culture, any style — and we'll make it flawlessly. That's our promise.

philosophy.label: Our Philosophy
philosophy.title: Just Your Imagination.
philosophy.paragraph1: We don't believe in fixed menus. You dream it — we cook it. From Ethiopian injera to Japanese kaiseki, from classic French to bold fusion — our chefs are masters across every cuisine and culture.
philosophy.paragraph2: Tell us what you're craving, and we'll source the finest ingredients, perfect the techniques, and present it with artistry. Any dish, any tradition, any dietary need — absolutely nothing is off the table.

services.label: Our Services
services.title:
Any Cuisine. Any
Culture. Any Style.
services.subtitle: Whether an intimate dinner for ten or a gala for three hundred, we bring the same exacting standards to every table.

cards.title: Private Dining
cards.text: Any cuisine, in your home or private venue — crafted around your craving, down to the last detail.

cards.title: Corporate Events
cards.text: Board meetings to galas — any cuisine, any culture, flawlessly executed at scale.

cards.title: Wedding Feasts
cards.text: Your heritage, your story, your favourite foods — we cook what you love for your biggest day.

menu.label: The Menu
menu.title:
You Tell Us
What to Cook.
menu.subtitle: Whatever you're craving — any cuisine, any dietary need, any style — we'll research, source, and perfect it to the highest standard.

cards.title:
Any Cuisine,
Any Tradition
cards.text: Thai, Ethiopian, Japanese, Italian, Lebanese, Mexican, Indian — our chefs are masters across every culinary culture. Nothing is beyond our reach.

cards.title:
Any Dietary Need,
Any Preference
cards.text: Vegan, keto, halal, kosher, gluten-free, allergen-safe — we don't just accommodate. We create dishes so good you'd never guess there was a restriction.

cards.title:
From Street Food
to Michelin Star
cards.text: Craving authentic Bangkok street food? A 12-course tasting menu? Grandma's secret recipe? We'll research, source, and perfect every dish.

items.text: We asked for an authentic Ethiopian feast with a modern twist — they delivered the most incredible meal we've ever had. These chefs can truly cook anything.
items.author: Catherine Whitmore

items.text: For our gala we wanted a fusion of Japanese and Peruvian cuisine. They didn't blink — just said 'tell us what you want' and created magic.
items.author: Harwood & Partners

items.text: My family is Lebanese and we wanted our wedding to reflect our heritage. raqt fuel made the most authentic tabbouleh and kibbeh I've had outside Beirut.
items.author: Nadia & Karim

items.text: Three of my team members have severe allergies. Not only did they accommodate everyone, but the food was so good nobody believed it was allergen-free.
items.author: Beaumont & Co.

teamPage.label: Our Team
teamPage.title: Crafting Every Craving
teamPage.subtitle: A team of world-class chefs, each a master in their culinary tradition, united by one belief: cook anything.

members.name: Marcus Thorne
members.bio: 20 years across Michelin kitchens in Paris, Tokyo and London. Flawless technique in French, Japanese and fusion cuisines.

members.name: Selina Okafor
members.bio: Born in Lagos, trained in Bangkok. Expert in West African, Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern flavours.

members.name: Dmitri Volkov
members.bio: Pastry chef trained in Vienna and Copenhagen. Known for modern patisserie that honours tradition.

members.name: Amara Chen
members.bio: Specialist in East Asian and plant-based cuisines. Turns dietary restrictions into culinary highlights.

members.name: Liam O'Sullivan
members.bio: 10 years orchestrating high-stakes catering for London's finest private and corporate events.

members.name: Priya Kapoor
members.bio: Explores and authenticates recipes from every culture. Her library of 200+ spice blends is our secret weapon.

values.title: No Limits
values.text: We never say no. Any cuisine, any culture, any dietary need — if you can dream it, we'll cook it.

values.title: Relentless Quality
values.text: Only the finest ingredients, perfected techniques, and meticulous presentation — every single time.

values.title: Personal Connection
values.text: We listen, we learn, and we cook your story. Every meal is a reflection of who you are and what you love.
